lines.trans: Dad, what about that one over there?
No, thin women are often mean.
Good, so we need a very kind one.
That woman over there, in my opinion, is very kind.
Listen, is she not a bit too old for me?
Well, in principle, this is a great option.
Meet him, please, he liked you very much.
My name is Valentina, very pleased to meet you.
I am helping you for the last time.
Alright, I have to go, and you two relax.
Konstantin, tell me, what do you do for a living?
It seems I am doing all kinds of nonsense today.

examples.text: Поэтому мы должны всё честно рассказать.
examples.trans: Therefore we must tell everything honestly.

examples.text: Света, слушай, я хочу кое-что сказать.
examples.trans: Sveta, listen, I want to tell you something.

examples.text: Слушай, ты мне что-то сказать хотел?
examples.trans: Listen, did you want to tell me something?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'егодня').

examples.text: Конечно, ведь сегодня мы идём в кино.
examples.trans: Of course, since today we are going to the cinema.

examples.text: Честно говоря, сегодня оно от су-шефа.
examples.trans: Honestly speaking, today it is from the sous-chef.

examples.text: Придумал, с кем сегодня отца познакомить?
examples.trans: Did you think of who to introduce your father to today?

всякий.gloss: every kind of, all sorts of, any

meanings.en: all sorts of, every kind of
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'який').

examples.text: Кажется, я сегодня занимаюсь всякой ерундой.
examples.trans: It seems I am doing all kinds of nonsense today.

examples.text: Ладно, всякое бывает.
examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen.

examples.text: Возьми зонт на всякий случай.
examples.trans: Take an umbrella just in case.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'nonsense, trifle, nothing' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Кажется, я сегодня занимаюсь всякой ерундой.
examples.trans: It seems I am doing all kinds of nonsense today.

examples.text: Перестань, не говори сейчас глупую ерунду.
examples.trans: Stop it, do not talk foolish nonsense right now.

examples.text: Да ерунда, мне даже нравится.
examples.trans: That's nothing, I even like it.
